tests.title: Home delivery shipping fee matches the shipping method rule and is charged in the order total
tests.goal: Customers pay the configured delivery fee, and the CRM order shows the same fee.
preconditions: The fee rule of a paid home-delivery method (e.g. 住宅送貨 or SF 住宅) read from CRM Online Store / shipping settings at runtime: flat or by weight
A QA member; a product with a weight > 0 (e.g. C, 1.000 kg) and a 0 kg product

steps.text: Add 1 x the weighted product, open /checkout, choose the home-delivery method and fill every Delivery Info field
Change quantity so the weight crosses the next weight band (if the rule is by weight)
Open the order in the CRM

expected.text: Step 1: Shipping Fee = the rule for that weight/region; Total = discounted total + shipping fee (+ rounding)
Step 2: Shipping Fee changes to the next band
Step 4: CRM Delivery Cost and Total equal the checkout values; Bank Transfer amount = Total

notes: Rules read in CRM Shipping: Testing flat 30 free from 1600 (discounted total), ShipAnySF350free flat 30 free from 350. C x1 + Testing: fee 30, Total 540 (510+30); TXN0126102800009 CRM Delivery Cost 30, Total 540, Bank Transfer 540. No weight-band method is configured (all weight rules off), so step 2 is n/a. Voided.

tests.title: Free-shipping threshold removes the fee at the threshold and adds it back when the basket drops below
tests.goal: The free-shipping rule uses the right amount (before or after discounts) and re-checks when the cart changes.
preconditions: A shipping method with a free-shipping threshold T, read from the shipping settings at runtime (the name ShipAnySF350free suggests T = 350; confirm)
A QA member; products to build baskets just below, at and above T

steps.text: Build a basket just below T, choose the method -> note the fee
Add items so the basket is exactly T, then above T
Apply a promo code that takes the discounted total below T
Remove items to go below T again

expected.text: Below T: the method's normal fee is charged
At T and above: Shipping Fee HKD 0.00
Step 3: the fee follows the documented basis (sub-total or discounted total); record which one the shop uses
Step 4: the fee is charged again without reloading

notes: Testing (T=1600): 510 -> 30; 894 -> 30; sub-total 1794 / discounted 1494 -> 30 (basis = discounted total after basket promo); 2088 -> 0; back to 1494 with - -> 30 again without reload. ShipAnySF350free: 510 and above -> 0. Not covered: exactly T (catalog prices cannot hit it) and a promo code as the discount.

tests.title: Changing the cart at checkout never leaves a shipping fee without a shipping method
tests.goal: The summary always matches the selected shipping method after the cart changes.
preconditions: A QA member; a weighted product (e.g. C, 1.000 kg) in the cart
A paid flat-fee method read from CRM Online Store > Shipping at runtime (e.g. Testing: flat HKD 30, free from HKD 1600)

steps.text: Open /checkout, choose the paid method -> note Shipping Fee and Total
Change the cart: + / - a quantity, or remove a line with the trash icon
Read Shipping Method and the Summary without reloading

expected.text: Step 1: Shipping Fee = the method fee, Total = Discounted Total + fee

Step 3: either the method stays selected and the fee is recomputed for the new basket, or the method is cleared and Shipping Fee shows '-' / 0 with Total = Discounted Total; never a fee with no method selected

notes: Trash and - both reset Shipping Method to -- Select -- but Summary kept Shipping Fee 30 in Total (924 / 540).

tests.title: Checkout refuses a delivery date outside the shipping method's allowed dates
tests.goal: Customers cannot book a delivery date the shop has blocked (date window, minimum preparation days) by typing it instead of using the picker.
preconditions: A shipping method whose Delivery Info has a date field with a date range and/or 'minimum preparation days', read from CRM Online Store > Shipping > edit method at runtime (e.g. Testing: field 'test', range and 5 prep days)
A QA member with a weighted product in the cart

steps.text: Open /checkout, choose the method and click the date field -> note which dates the picker allows
Type a blocked date with the keyboard (today, or a date after the range), Tab out
Type text that is not a date, Tab out
Tick the agreement and Proceed to checkout with a blocked date
CRM: open the order (if one was created) and read Delivery Info

expected.text: Step 2-3: a blocked or invalid value is cleared or flagged; it never becomes a different date silently
Step 4: refused with a message about the delivery date; no order
Step 5: no order exists; if one does, its date is within the allowed dates

notes: Picker blocks every date; typed text became today 2026-10-28 and TXN0126102800010 was placed with it (5 prep days required). Voided.
